svg.title: Plot Speaks technical design
svg.desc: Players use their own AI assistant (Claude, Gemini and others). The assistant calls the Plot Speaks MCP server, a Cloudflare Worker that holds every answer key and runs the game engines, with D1, KV, Workers AI and static assets behind it. Stories are linted and built into the Worker; the public repository holds the stories without their answer keys.
svg.text: Voice games and stories played with your own AI assistant. The assistant narrates; the server keeps every answer.

Game engines (the server decides; the narrator reads)
Story submissions: lint → Llama Guard 3 → daily caps → a person approves → cover
The narrator never holds an answer key: the Worker returns one line at a time
ESPN site API: team rosters (6 h cache)
4. From a story file to production
A scanned export of the stories (without answer keys), the lint and playtest tools, the Worker source and its tests.
Answer keys exist only in the private working copy and inside the deployed Worker.
